_comment: AUTHORED. The ?provider= scope, which design 1.1 lists because it is a different code path from the portfolio view — most visibly per_provider_burn, which is null under a filter and populated without one. Seeded identically to metered-usage so the difference between this scenario's summary.json and that one is attributable to the filter alone and nothing else. NOTE the scope is PER SURFACE, not per directory: only /dashboard/summary and /dashboard/trend accept provider/instance_key. /dashboard/breakdown and /report take no filter at all, so their files here are portfolio payloads and must not be read as evidence of filtered behaviour. That is not a defect in the fixture — it is what a user with a provider selected actually sees, a filtered hero and trend beside a portfolio breakdown, with the report a separate portfolio route.
name: provider-filtered

request._comment: Per-surface request scope. A surface named here is called with these parameters; a surface absent is called with none. The capture code reads this map rather than applying one request to everything, so a scenario cannot silently claim a scope the route does not support.
